definitionZh: 包含的 CSS 属性表明,一个元素及其内容尽可能独立于文档树的其他部分. 封装可以隔离DOM的一个小节,通过将布局,样式,油漆,大小或任何组合的计算限制在一个DOM子树上而不是整个页面,从而提供性能效益. 封装还可以用于范围CSS计数器和引文.
sourceDefinition: The contain CSS property indicates that an element and its contents are, as much as possible, independent from the rest of the document tree. Containment enables isolating a subsection of the DOM, providing performance benefits by limiting calculations of layout, style, paint, size, or any combination to a DOM subtree rather than the entire page. Containment can also be used to scope CSS counters and quotes.
